description: Put categories away, or bring them back. Give `archive_ids` and `restore_ids` to say exactly which — these work at any time. On a document that holds no account and no transaction yet, `keep_ids` is also accepted and archives everything not listed, which is the fast way to trim the shipped list; it is refused afterwards, when one forgotten id would archive a category out from under a year of transactions. Archiving is not deleting — the history stays and comes back with it — and system categories are never touched. Ids come from category_tree. On a document that already holds work it takes a timestamped .bak first.

archive_ids.description: Categories to put away. Their transactions keep pointing at them.

keep_ids.description: Empty document only: every id to keep. Everything else is archived. Refused once the document holds an account or a transaction.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: choose_categories
title: Archive or restore categories
